title: ESAM exp3 frozen gt targets
why: Isolates the quality of the targets. Same frozen recipe as exp2, but the student is trained on the exact per-point SceneNN instance ids instead of the ESAM-E pseudo instances. If this run learns clearly better instances than exp2, the ESAM-E teacher is the limiting factor; if it behaves the same, the limit is the recipe itself (a randomly initialised TinyExpert behind a frozen decoder).
name: ESAM++ Tiny student - frozen shared layers, ground truth targets
